claims: The Cincinnati Reds open the 2026 MLB season at home against the Boston Red Sox on Thursday, March 26, 2026, at 4:10 p.m. ET at Great American Ball Park.
Andrew Abbott is scheduled to make his first career Opening Day start for the Cincinnati Reds.
Andrew Abbott is a left-hander.
Andrew Abbott faces Garrett Crochet.
Garrett Crochet is a left-hander for the Boston Red Sox.
The Opening Day matchup is Boston Red Sox vs. Cincinnati Reds.
The 2026 Opening Day date is Thursday, March 26, 2026.
The 2026 Opening Day time is 4:10 p.m. ET.
The Opening Day location is Great American Ball Park, Cincinnati, OH.
The Cincinnati Reds Opening Day starter is Andrew Abbott (LHP).
The Boston Red Sox Opening Day starter is Garrett Crochet (LHP).
Hunter Greene will miss Opening Day.
Hunter Greene starts the 2026 season on the injured list following elbow surgery.
Infielder Matt McLain led major league baseball in several offensive categories, including home runs, during spring training.
